name: SNAKE & DRAGON: World's End Parade
source:
It's the final confrontation with the villain. The fate of the world hinges on this.

But something went wrong, didn't it?  Things didn't go as expected.

In times like these.... miracles usually happen, don't they?

.....So where's the miracle?

This is a bad end story, about two robots navigating the apocalypse.

[From [url=https://anpucamilla.itch.io/worlds-end-parade]itch.io[/url]]
